Home.title: Offering the best of entertainment
Home.subtitle: Digital gift cards and subscriptions paid in kwanzas and delivered in minutes. No international card, no hassle — simple, fast and secure.
Home.popularSubtitle: Music, shows, AI and storage — at the brands' own prices, converted to kwanzas.
Home.stepsSubtitle: From click to code in your inbox in three steps.

choose.title: Pick what you want
choose.body: Subscriptions, gift cards or the StreamOut Bundle. You see the final price in kwanzas before paying.

pay.title: Pay in kwanzas
pay.body: Multicaixa Express, reference or bank transfer. You confirm on your phone — we never see your PIN.

receive.title: Get it in minutes
receive.body: Your code arrives by email and in your account, with the invoice. Made-to-order items arrive within 30 minutes.

GiftCards.note: Face value converted at {rate} Kz/USD. US-region cards.

Bundle.title: Everything you love, in one package
Bundle.subtitle: Combine several subscriptions in one payment, save up to 15% and get a discount on everything else in the store.
Bundle.noCard: Pay in kwanzas. No international card needed.

what.a: An exclusive StreamOut package that combines subscriptions from several brands in one payment, for 3, 6 or 12 months, with a discount over buying each separately.

how.q: How do I receive each subscription?
how.a: You get each service's code by email and in your StreamOut account. Some arrive instantly; others within 30 minutes.

discount.q: How does the discount on other purchases work?
discount.a: While your bundle is active, your plan's discount (5%, 10% or 15%) is applied automatically to every other purchase when you're signed in.

change.a: Yes. When your period ends you can renew with a different plan or duration. We remind you before it expires.

HowItWorks.title: Simple, fast and secure
HowItWorks.subtitle: Digital purchases without an international card: pay in kwanzas and get your code in minutes.
HowItWorks.securitySubtitle: We protect every step, from sign-in to the code you receive.

pin.title: Your PIN stays with you
pin.body: With Multicaixa Express you confirm the payment in your own app. We don't store card data.

otp.title: Two-step verification
otp.body: Every sign-in asks for a code sent by email or SMS.

encryption.title: Encrypted codes
encryption.body: Your codes and credentials are stored with strong encryption and only shown after you confirm it's you.

invoice.title: An invoice for every order
invoice.body: You receive the invoice by email as soon as the payment is confirmed.

delivery.a: "Instant delivery" items arrive in seconds. Items marked "Within 30 min" are bought by our team and sent within 30 minutes.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Multicaixa Express, payment by reference and bank transfer — always in kwanzas.

region.q: Do the codes work in Angola?
region.a: Codes are US-region. Some platforms require the account to be set to that region; we always explain how to redeem each code.

refund.a: If we can't deliver on time, we refund the full amount. Codes that have already been revealed can't be refunded, as they can't be recovered.

invoice.a: Yes. Invoices are issued by certified software and emailed to you once the payment is confirmed.

account.q: Do I need an account to buy?
account.a: No, but with an account you keep all your subscriptions in one place, get reminders before they expire and the Bundle discount.

Chat.title: StreamOut Assistant
Chat.welcome: Hi! 👋 I'm the StreamOut assistant. I can help with payments, delivery, the Bundle or any catalog question.
Chat.fallback: I'm not sure I understood. Pick one of the options below or ask to talk to the team.

answers.hello: Hi! How can I help? Payments, delivery, the Bundle or prices?
answers.payment: We accept Multicaixa Express, reference and bank transfer — always in kwanzas. With Multicaixa Express you confirm in your app with your PIN; we never see it.
answers.delivery: "Instant delivery" items reach your email and account in seconds. Items marked "Within 30 min" are bought by our team and sent within 30 minutes.
answers.bundle: The StreamOut Bundle combines several subscriptions in one payment (3, 6 or 12 months), saves up to 15% and gives you up to 15% off other purchases. See StreamOut Bundle in the menu.
answers.prices: Prices follow each brand's official price, converted to kwanzas at the BNA rate. You see the final total before paying.
answers.refund: If we can't deliver on time, we refund the full amount. Codes that have already been revealed can't be refunded.
answers.security: We use two-step verification at sign-in, store codes encrypted and never store card data.
answers.human: Sure! Our team replies on Instagram @streamout.services. WhatsApp is coming soon.
